notes.title: Future Plans For Tricky Tracks
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey guys, how's it going?[/b][/h3]
It's been a while and we hope that some of you are still reading along. Almost a year ago, we pressed the release button for Tricky Tracks and were so happy that you liked the game. Unfortunately, there was always one thing: too few players. That hasn't changed to this day.
We still think our game has potential and we want to try a few more things to finally realize that potential. 

[u][b]As a first step:[/b][/u] We are going to greatly reduce the price of Tricky Tracks. We hope to attract more players with a price below 5 Dollar/Euro and make the game more fun for all of you.

[u][b]The second step:[/b][/u] Will be an upcoming update that will bring the game up to the latest versions of Unity, Fusion, Vivox and generally all the technologies we use in the game. We want to continue to offer you a great and stable gaming experience as much as we can.


We really hope that we can build a bigger player base, because that's the only way to make a multiplayer game work.

notes.title: 15% OFF to celebrate new game mode! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3][b]It's here, people! A new game mode for Tricky Tracks! 😎[/b][/h3]
The last few weeks, we've been working hard to give you guys a new experience - the all new Traitor Zombie Mode! 
And to celebrate this, we're participating in the current Steam sale. You'll get [b]15% off[/b] of your purchase of Tricky Tracks!


[u]How does the new game mode work?[/u]
[list][*] Everyone seemingly looks the same. Everyone's on the RUNNER team. Except one.
[*] The Traitor RUNNER must catch the others and turn them into traitors.
[*] If every RUNNER has been zombified, the (traitor) SEEKER team wins.
[*] If just one RUNNER survives the match time, the RUNNER team wins.
[*] NEW MECHANIC for the SEEKER gun: If you hit a RUNNER, they are now on your traitor team. (No need to get near to your prey 👀)
[/list]

You can pick the Traitor Zombie mode while opening a new session: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165067/5e10926fe2c07d4ff3c05ba9254e3897e567d5a9.png[/img]

Beware: This game mode is still in active development and may cause minor bugs. If you do run into issues, please feel free to join our Discord and post them into our bug reports channel.
You can also find other players there and assemble your team!

We'd love to hear what you think about this new game mode!


[url=https://discord.gg/bmVyeU7Y9m]Discord[/url]


[b]PS: If you're a streamer and interested in a giveaway for Tricky Tracks Steam keys for your community, hit us up.[/b]

notes.title: News about the current play-test
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone, important news regarding the play-test version of Tricky Tracks[/h2]

As our Early Access release is getting nearer, we decided to close the current play-test. 
[b]Of course, the demo will stay online[/b]. Speaking of it, the demo has reached a very good point where it is almost finished with the content it should have. 

It gives you a good understanding of what Tricky Tracks is about: You can practice against a bot, 4 different maps are waiting for you to chase each other and all in all it is a pretty good representation of what awaits you. And of course, it is free and it will stay free.
The demo will get updates like bug fixes or quality of life improvements but it won’t get more content. This is reserved for the Early Access version 😉

As the EA release gets closer, we need to have some kind of a “test environment” where we and our group of testers can put everything to the acid test. 
[list]
[*][h3]Sneak peak: The first thing we will need to test is the upcoming Dwarven Dungeon Map[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165067/21049b3daf14a3b4782da494dae97ae94b2ce3f9.png[/img]
[/list]

We will open a new play-test but this time it will be a closed and hidden one. Every one of our current testers will get an invite and also every tier 2 patron on [url=https://www.patreon.com/rainlight]Patreon[/url] will get access to it. 

Our [url=https://discord.gg/EurYgCAYj4]Discord[/url] is the main hub for collecting feedback and talk about ideas. Everyone is welcome to join!

notes.title: Our plans for different versions of Tricky Tracks
notes.content:
Hey everybody, here we want to briefly explain how we want to keep it with the two versions (Play-Test and Demo) of Tricky Tracks.

[h2]Play-Test[/h2]
Until Early-Access launch this will always be the most recent, FREE version of Tricky Tracks. See it as a “beta branch” because this build, being the most recent one, might also contain more or even game breaking bugs. This version will be updated via our own launcher, just like you are used to. Since it is free, the scope of the game is limited but you should get a good idea of what Tricky Tracks is about 😊

[h2]Demo[/h2]
We plan to keep the Demo of Tricky Tracks online for as long as it needs to be. The Demo version will be the most stable branch of the current development. It could be that it misses some of the newest features which are already playable in the Play-Test version. In contrast we try to make this the most stable version without game breaking bugs. So, you will always have a reliable, stable version. This will use Steam for updates, not our own launcher. The updates will also be less frequent. This Demo version is and will stay free, so the scope of it is also limited but you should get a good idea of what Tricky Tracks is about 😊

notes.title: Hey there and thank you
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there[/h2]
This is Sakura (RainCrafts) and Jan (LightYarn) the two developers of Tricky Tracks.
We want to use this very first posting to thank all of you who put Tricky Tracks on their Wishlist <3

For you it might only be a tiny little click but for us it means so much more! With every player who adds our game to their Wishlist we not only get a huge motivation boost, because we see that you guys are actually interested in what we are working on so hard, but you also boost our game when it comes to Steam’s internal statistics. With every click you show Steam “Hey, this game is interesting” and with every click our chances raise to actually make Tricky Tracks a popular and fun game to play.

We are so excited to embark on this journey of our first game with all of you on board and we can’t wait to see all the things to come! Let’s make Tricky Tracks the game we all love to play =)

Thanks a bunch,
RainLight
